title: Bick et al What Work Does Generative AI Do author account
population: United States; RPS adults aged 18 to 64; work-use measure among workers
definition: Self-reported generative-AI use for jobs, not business installations or the complete proposed workflow.
finding: Work-use share rose from 33% to 45% between the stated observations.
limitation: Author summary of original survey research; not a matched textile-marketing denominator or an audited deployment measure.

title: ONS Artificial intelligence in UK businesses 2023 to 2026
observed: Late 2023 to June 2026; June evidence uses BICS Wave 159
population: UK BICS businesses; cited headline comparison is businesses with 10 or more employees; excluded industries listed in methods.
definition: Any listed AI technology; the measure does not distinguish light use from embedded production.
finding: Headline use increased from around 12% to around 35% in that population.
limitation: All AI, not solely generative AI; UK geography and size threshold do not match the hypothetical US/China team.

title: US Census Bureau BTOS AI Core Question Updates
definition: Question changed from producing goods/services to any business function.
finding: Census identifies a level shift and starts a new series.
limitation: A measurement break is not evidence of acceleration across the break; document is not a current installed-base count.

title: Allen Monitoring AI Adoption in the US Economy
observed: Through 2025; see source for survey-specific windows
population: Compares firms, individual workers and workforce-weighted exposure
definition: Different samples and units of analysis
finding: The note explains why business and individual survey rates differ.
limitation: Used for measurement interpretation, not the latest October 2026 prevalence.

title: Everett M Rogers Diffusion of Innovations fifth edition
observed: Conceptual source; no present-day diffusion measurement
population: Framework for innovation diffusion through social systems
definition: Adopter categories and perceived innovation attributes
finding: Course-specified framework: relative advantage, compatibility, complexity, trialability and observability.
limitation: Publisher page verifies bibliographic identity; definitions are operationalized from the assigned memo, not quoted from an accessed full book.
